back: Oscillation perpendicular to the direction of energy transfer (e.g. light, string waves).
Oscillation parallel to the direction of energy transfer, with compressions and rarefactions (e.g. sound).
Shortest distance between two points oscillating in phase, e.g. crest to crest.
Longitudinal mechanical wave; needs a medium; ≈340 m s⁻¹ in air.
Transverse oscillating E and B fields; no medium needed; c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ in a vacuum.
